messages:
Maria: Kicking off quant-v2p1 small-batch canary at 10% traffic. Observed earlier that preempted leases killed KV warmup -> short-term hallucinations. Starting now: https://dashboard.redwood.ai/canaries/7190012345 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary started on cluster-gamma, variant=quant-v2p1-nf4, traffic=10%, started_by=Maria

Jonah: Can you paste the A/B slice metrics? specifically MRR, hallucination-rate, latency p95.

Maria: Quick snapshot from the smoke eval (1000 requests sampled): MRR delta -0.25% (not sig), hallucination-rate up 1.7% absolute (baseline 2.1% -> 3.8%), p95 latency +12ms. Raw: https://telemetry.redwood.ai/snapshot/7190012345

Anika: 1.7% looks concerning. Our auto-fallback threshold is 1.0% absolute uplift in hallucination on critical slices. Did we hit sample size for CI? :warning:

Jonah: sample size ~1k per arm -> borderline. Need 5k for tight CI on hallucination. But the spike coincides with several preempts in logs:
```
[2026-03-21T12:03:10Z] lease=preempted node=gamma-07 reason=low-gpu-memory
[2026-03-21T12:03:12Z] kv_warmup=miss session_id=xyz
```

Samir: Two actions: (1) increase minibatch to 8 (reduces preempt churn), (2) holdback flag to 20% for 30m window OR auto-fallback on sustained hallucination >1.0% for 15m sliding. Proposed gating config:
```yaml
canary:
  traffic: 10%
  min_sample: 5000
  max_holdback: 20%
  sliding_window: 15m
  auto_fallback:
    metric: hallucination_rate
    absolute_delta: 1.0
    duration: 15m
```

Anika: Agree. Also enable kv_warmup_policy: `pinned_warmup: true` for the canary variant. That should cut transient spikes.

Maria: Rolling config change now: minibatch=8, pinned_warmup true, min_sample target 5k. Deploy-bot warned about 2 more preempts scheduled in the next 10m (maintenance). I'll pause ramp until after maintenance. :hand:

deploy-bot: Canary paused by Maria. reason=scheduled_maintenance window=2026-03-21T12:10Z-12:20Z

Jonah: After we reach 5k and the maintenance clears, let's run a 30m steady watch and if hallucination delta <= 0.5% and MRR delta >= -0.5% promote to 25% then 50% with same gates.

Samir: +1. Also adding an offline concordance eval to catch subtle regressions (rank recall on benchmark set). Will post results in #canary-evals thread.

Maria: Thanks all. Will update thread when we resume. :rocket:
